summary: Backend engineer with infrastructure depth and 5+ years building and stabilizing API and data systems across healthcare, finance, retail, and B2B platforms. Combines .NET/SQL and Python/FastAPI backend work with cloud delivery, Terraform, and CI/CD, including 20-30 REST APIs and a healthcare workflow cut from 5-8 minutes to 5 seconds.

bullets: Moved a contract platform from an EC2-style deployment to Cloud Run. Split dev/prod resources, moved secrets to Secret Manager, and replaced long-lived CI credentials with Workload Identity Federation.
Refactored a FastAPI prototype into domain modules, added SQLAlchemy/Alembic persistence and runtime validation, and covered the new paths with pytest, pyright, and ruff.
Set up the project's first deployable AWS environment with Terraform-managed EC2, OIDC-based GitHub Actions, S3 remote state, Docker Compose, and CloudWatch health and log checks.
Cut healthcare admin-page load time from 5-8 minutes to 5 seconds, with a 0.4-second best case, by moving multi-table query logic from AutoMapper into SQL Server procedures, views, and functions.
Created the company's first AWS dev/test environment for a 40-50 API financial-system takeover, removing the need for client VPN access; added 4-5 APIs and passed on-site acceptance.
Maintained GitLab CE and CI runners used by roughly 100-150 engineers. Built a production-like upgrade environment and automated recurring cleanup and maintenance with Bash and Cron.
Designed 20-30 REST APIs with JWT authentication, transaction-safe writes, NSwag documentation, structured logging, SQL Server, and Angular integration.
Maintained order, inventory, quotation, and member workflows for a nationwide B2B platform used by IT / 3C resellers, enterprise customers, and internal sales teams.
Fixed production defects and cross-database query issues in AngularJS/.NET ERP code spanning SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle.
Built an Angular 8/.NET MVC 5 migration proof of concept and presented the approach to the ERP engineering team.
